change.what_changed: Initial publication (S-DOI-1c canary edition). Government-limit standard (HMTc Method v2.0): each analyte is the strictest applicable finalized sovereign maximum by lookup, converted to the as-sold basis, with disclosed read-across where no government regulates the exact product form and reflex Cr-VI speciation where total chromium is not a material toxic in the matrix. 11-cell panel verified 11/11 against primary instrument text (canary A): Pb 20 (EU 2023/915 3.1.26), Cd 40 (EU 3.2.20), tAs 50 (FSSAI 2011), iAs subsumed by tAs (EU 3.4 routes rice cereal via 3.4.1 rice-products, not 3.4.3 baby-food; strictest finished iAs 100 bounded to 50 by tAs), tHg 8 read-across (Israel FCS-2016), MeHg subsumed by tHg, Ni 3000 (EU 2024/1987 processed-cereal-infant-food), Sn 5000 (FSSAI 2011, non-canned), Al 500 read-across (FSANZ Sch19, no gov Al ML for cereal), Cr not-material/reflex-control, Cr-VI subsumed by Cr.
change.why: Establish the immutable-edition contract on the S-DOI-1b page of record before any bulk fan-out.

canary_bundle.note: S-DOI-GRAPH-1 corrected edition. Bundle (freeze + deposit-edition, both custody adapters pending GATE 1) staged locally in the session scratchpad, NOT shipped to static/, NOT minted, NOT deposited, no cert push. frozen_artifact stays null until custody is actually sealed — the edition is claim-hash-pinned (silent-change-guarded) but not yet frozen-resolvable (Daubert honesty invariant).

change.what_changed: Total chromium (Cr) cell corrected from not_material/null (reflex Cr-VI control only) to a government limit of 1000 ug/kg (regulatory-alignment, as_sold). Cr-VI remains subsumed beneath the total by reflex speciation; its binding_parent_value moves null → 1000.
government_instruments: Hong Kong Cap 132V Food Adulteration (Metallic Contamination) Regulations, item 7 Chromium, Cereals = 1 mg/kg
China GB 2762-2022, grains and grain products including cereals and milled grain products, Cr = 1.0 mg/kg
change.why: S-DOI-GRAPH-1 diamond-graph method canary (independent per-cell finder + two perspective-diverse adversarial verifiers, corroborating at 0.90/0.95) refuted the prior not-material determination: two finalized in-force sovereign total-Cr MLs for cereals on the exact as_sold basis already existed in the register, and a dry rice-based infant cereal is a cereal/grain product. Under the frozen method lock a null ceiling is looser than a verified 1000 floor (never blank; lowest applicable finalized government limit binds), so the not-material/null cell was a method-lock violation.
change.non_material_note: basis_note/label prose trimmed for layout on 2026-09-10 — NOT a version bump (schema v2 excludes free-text prose from the claim hash); claim_hash re-recorded under algorithm v2 (same certification content: Cr 1000 gov HK).

canary_bundle.note: S-DOI-FORCE-1 full-panel-numeric edition. Bundle staged locally in session scratchpad, NOT static/, NOT minted, NOT deposited, no push. frozen_artifact null until custody sealed.

change.what_changed: Speciated analytes now publish their numeric parent-bound ceiling instead of value:null — iAs 50 (bounded by tAs), MeHg 8 (bounded by tHg), Cr-VI 1000 (bounded by total Cr). All are reflex-assayed (measured only when the parent total is exceeded). Full 11-cell panel is now numeric; zero blank/monitored/subsumed-blank cells. Species cells also carry inherited attribution (binding_jurisdiction + claim_disposition from the parent) so the claim surface shows a real jurisdiction/disposition, not a blank.
change.why: ORDER S-DOI-FORCE-1 enforcing the ratified Certification-Readiness Ruling (2026-08-25): every panel analyte resolves to a firm numeric ceiling; a species is bounded by its parent total; never value:null. Reflex speciation is assay timing, not blanking. Stops shipping blank/subsumed claim cells.

canary_bundle.note: S-DOI-TAS-1 edition: tAs restored as a distinct total row; rice iAs = direct FDA 100. Bundle staged locally, not static/, not minted, no push.

change.what_changed: Inorganic arsenic (iAs) now publishes its own direct sovereign limit, US FDA 100 ug/kg for infant rice cereal (type gov, jurisdiction US), instead of being bounded to the total-arsenic value 50. Total arsenic (tAs 50, India) is rendered as a distinct total row (it was previously dropped by a renderer bug that listed iAs in the totals slot). Claim surface is now 9 rows: 8 totals + iAs.

change.why: ORDER S-DOI-TAS-1: freeze PDF dropped the total-arsenic row (printed iAs instead of tAs). The 8 totals must include tAs, and rice carries a mandatory numeric iAs (its direct FDA limit). The binding arsenic constraint remains the tighter total (tAs 50); iAs 100 is the FDA species standard, both published.
